points.description: Names meteorological factors: wind speed, air and water temperature, vapour pressure (vapour pressure difference), and atmospheric pressure. Any correct ones, with at least 3 of these 4 for full marks.
points.partial_credit: Half mark for 1–2 of these factors correctly named.

points.description: Names water-body related factors: heat storage by the water body and water quality (e.g. salinity or dissolved solids). Both needed for full marks.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only one of the two is given.

rubric.notes: Full marks need most of the model factors across both groups: meteorological (wind speed, temperature, vapour pressure, atmospheric pressure) and water-body (heat storage, water quality). Give part marks when only one group is covered or only a few factors are named. Clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. humidity for vapour pressure, salinity for water quality). Wrong or unrelated factors earn nothing but do not cancel correct ones.
